sections.title: Valuation Insights
sections.text: Visa delivers a high operating margin of [[V.ratio.operating_margin]] and a strong return on average equity of [[V.ratio.return_on_average_equity]]. Debt-to-equity stands at [[V.ratio.debt_to_equity]], indicating moderate leverage. Free cash flow of [[V.ratio.free_cash_flow]] supports ongoing share repurchases and dividend growth. The annual price‑earnings multiple of [[V.ratio.price_earnings]] reflects market expectations relative to earnings.

insight.text: Operating margin stays close to sixty percent, underscoring robust profitability.
